description: Change how the workspace's AI assistant automatically answers the business's real customers on WhatsApp (and any other connected chat channel it answers). The change applies to the next customer messages straight away, the previous values are overwritten, and turning ai_replies_enabled on makes the AI reply to customers by itself (each reply uses an AI credit). Pass ONLY the settings the merchant asked to change, inside "settings": ai_replies_enabled (bool), instructions (the full new instructions text — read them first with get_ai_assistant_settings and keep what the merchant did not ask to remove), working_hours (weekly schedule object or null), outside_hours_message_enabled (bool), outside_hours_message, pause_bot_after_handoff (bool), pause_after_manual_reply_minutes (0-1440), count_mcp_as_manual_reply (bool, default false — when true, messages sent through MCP tools like this one pause the bot for pause_after_manual_reply_minutes; when false they never pause it), count_api_as_manual_reply (bool, default false — the same for messages sent through the REST API; LetsBot's own automatic notices never count), transfer_voice_to_agent (bool), voice_note_mode (reply|silent|react), extra_rules, timezone, and dialect / tone when get_ai_assistant_settings lists them.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to change the AI settings.

name: update_ai_assistant_settings
